Oncall Bot: INCIDENT CREATED — service=redwood-inference, symptom=streaming token stalls + p99 spike, severity=sev2, runbook=https://confluence.internal/infra/incidents

Amelia (SRE): getting paged, seeing p99 jump on streaming endpoints for model=gptx-7b-int8-calib around 23:02 UTC. p95 up ~2x, p99 up ~5x.

Cynthia (Support): customer Dan reported timeouts during long chat sessions, said they hit 'stalled' streaming frames and UI hung for ~10s before retry. Customer impact: some customers in EU.

Josh (ML Infra): rolling out int8 calibration profile last night for latency improvements. Telemetry shows KV cache hits dropped at same time. suspect calibration fallout that changes token schedule.

Priya (Runtime): logs show repeated dequantization retries and KV lookup contention on nodes in eu-west-1. stack traces: ``ERROR runtime::kv_cache - miss_rate=0.83; dequant_retries=12; stalled_streams=94``

Amelia (SRE): can we isolate to model variant? Which pools are serving int8-calib vs fp8?

Josh (ML Infra): int8-calib is in pool: rl-prod-eu-02. fp8-fallback in rl-prod-eu-03. Traffic split 80/20 after canary.

Amelia (SRE): traffic manager -> can we shift canary to 0 and route all requests to fp8-fallback now? Need to reduce p99 ASAP. @Priya please execute fallback routing.

Priya (Runtime): doing routing change: ``routes set --pool rl-prod-eu-02=0 --pool rl-prod-eu-03=1 --model gptx-7b``. Applying now.

Oncall Bot: ROUTE UPDATE: change submitted by Priya. Status=applied.

Amelia (SRE): observing initial metrics — p95 dropping within 30s, p99 still noisy. Streaming stalls count down from 94 -> 30 over 2m.

Josh (ML Infra): rolling rollback of int8 calibration profile on rl-prod-eu-02 in parallel — ``deploy rollback --model gptx-7b --profile int8-calib``. This will prevent accidental reassignment.

Priya (Runtime): also enabling prefix KV cache warmup for long-context sessions: ``kvcache warmup --model gptx-7b --sample 5000``. Hoping to reduce cold misses.

Cynthia (Support): Dan, can you confirm if your users see improvement?

Dan (Customer): reporting: initial UX improvements, fewer hangs, but one user still saw a 6s stall. Overall better after your change. Thanks.

Amelia (SRE): drilling into logs — correlation with dequant nodes spiking cpu during rolling calibration. Node-level p99 token latency = 720ms vs baseline 120ms. Suspect code path in int8 dequant path that regresses under some attention sizes.

Josh (ML Infra): ack. Tagging model team to run calibration validation. Will open a postmortem for the int8 profile rollout. For live mitigation: keeping fp8 route and paused int8 rollout.

Priya (Runtime): temporary mitigation checklist executed: 1) route -> fp8; 2) pause int8 canary; 3) warm KV; 4) increase streaming timeouts for clients by 2s to reduce perceived failures. Pushing a config roll: ``config set --service streaming_timeout=12s``.

Oncall Bot: ALERT: downtime risk lowered. Severity re-evaluated -> sev3.

Amelia (SRE): capturing impact: 17 customer sessions affected, 3 escalations, no data loss. Taking paging handoff in 30m to postmortem squad.

Cynthia (Support): will send a short customer update: "We experienced elevated streaming latency for some sessions. We rolled back a calibration change and routed traffic to a fallback model; the issue is mitigated and we are investigating root cause."

Josh (ML Infra): next steps: full calibration audit, add regression test with long context and variable attention sizes, add KV warmup to canary rollouts.

Priya (Runtime): creating follow-up runbook entry: add explicit checks for dequant retry counts and stall-rate alerts.

Amelia (SRE): will own timeline and postmortem. If anyone sees a p99 climb after routing changes are reverted, re-pager immediately. :rotating_light:

Dan (Customer): appreciate the quick response. Please keep us posted.

Amelia (SRE): last note — record of commands used in thread for handoff:
```
# routing
routes set --pool rl-prod-eu-02=0 --pool rl-prod-eu-03=1 --model gptx-7b
# rollback
deploy rollback --model gptx-7b --profile int8-calib
# kv warmup
kvcache warmup --model gptx-7b --sample 5000
# config
config set --service streaming_timeout=12s
```
Amelia (SRE): transferring to Postmortem channel in 30m for RCA. Thread closed for live ops. :white_check_mark:
